# The State of AI Brand Visibility 2026

Across 24 buyer categories and 120 brands, AI answer engines named a single dominant brand in every buyer question in 23 of 24 categories — while 10% of brands were never recommended at all.

- AI answers are winner-take-most. In 23 of 24 categories, the leading brand was recommended in 100% of buyer questions — far more concentrated than classic search, where ten results share the page.

- Invisibility is common. 10 % of the 120 brands measured were never mentioned at all. Being a real option in the market does not mean the AI knows you exist.

- The leader still shares the stage. Even the top brand captured only ~ 26 % of total mentions on average — there is room for challengers who optimize for AI answers (AEO/GEO).

- This is measurable and movable. Brand visibility in AI answers can be tracked over time and improved, the same way SEO rankings can.

For each category we asked AI answer engines a set of realistic buyer questions and recorded which brands were recommended, how often, and their share of voice. Visibility is the share of buyer questions in which a brand is mentioned; share of voice is a brand’s portion of all brand mentions in the category. Figures track the live No Niner AI Visibility Index and update over time.
